title: Göbekli Tepe datable because it was buried

tellings.quote: GOC teepe was dated the only reason they were able to date gockley teepe is because the site was believed to be buried

plain: Göbekli Tepe, an ancient stone site in Turkey, could only be dated because it was buried, says a researcher named Matt LaCroix. He tells Michels this without naming a source, and the point is that being buried is what let scientists put an age on the site at all.
